scenes.spoken_script: Why does Gibson's public checkbook show a pattern nobody's explaining in plain language?
The county's own public servers show something that doesn't match how normal budgets look.

One weird line in a budget can be nothing. A cluster of weird lines in the same year is why auditors — and taxpayers — start asking questions on the record. The flagged line: Gibson FY2025: fund 'Settlement' — 'Distributions to Other Governmental Entities' is 100% of fund disbursements ($71,529,856 / $71,529,856) Could be innocent — but it's public money and the explanation should be on the record.
Every number here is from Gibson County 'Settlement' fund — $71.5 MILLION concentrated in one line. Source: public county records. Not an accusat. You can verify it yourself tonight.
An unexplained pattern in Gibson's books — your money until someone explains it.
Share this in your local group — public money deserves public answers.
